title: Half-Day Wine Tastings in the North GA Mountains from Atlanta
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult
policies: We use a 23 passenger shuttle with large windows and plenty of space with reclining seats. Depending on demand and/or our service schedule, we reserve the right to substitute vehicles

Look for a small white shuttle bus with "Atlanta Sightseeing" on the side of the bus. The bus does not have a restroom so make sure you use the restroom before you arrive. There are phone outlets under your seat to charge your phone. Please bring your charger with you if you want to charge your phone.
Please arrive at the meeting point 20 minutes before the activity starts. The bus will leave exactly at the start time.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Leaving Atlanta and enjoy a half-day excursion to the North Georgia Wine Country. This tour is designed for guest who are only visiting for a short amount of time or they are only available in the afternoon. Admire the rolling hills and vineyards that make up Georgia’s premier wine region.  Visit two celebrated wineries for approximately 9 wine tastings. After the wine tastings we will return back to Atlanta
